## Validation and limitations
- Every source row was checked for FUTCOM, requested symbol, actual expiry, and dates within the target range. Symbol whitespace was ignored for verification only; raw CSVs preserve it.
- GOLDTEN begins 2025-03-31 in the returned data; earliest listed expiry is 30APR2025. No pre-listing data was fabricated.
- All 165 relevant observed expiry options have verified files. Completeness beyond the expiry list exposed by MCX was not independently established.
- CSV columns: Date, Instrument Name, Symbol, Expiry Date, Option Type, Strike Price, Open, High, Low, Close, Previous Close, Volume(Lots), Volume(In 000's), Value(Lacs), Open Interest(Lots).
- No separate official settlement-price field exists in these exports. Close was not relabelled. No supplementary settlement report was downloaded.
- Dates in source CSVs use textual month names. Requests initially used DD/MM/YYYY; resumed page controls used native ISO dates. Files were checked against actual returned dates.
- No options, unrelated commodities, continuous near-month series, cleaning, normalization, indicators or financial analysis is included. Zero-volume rows are retained.
- Download events sometimes produced missing paths or repeated the preceding contract. Retries recovered all identified expiries. Exact duplicate source exports are represented once in the archive.
- Log limitation: two transient retry manifests were unavailable after resuming. Their attempt lists were reconstructed from saved queues and conversation evidence; those individual attempts are conservatively marked failed when their retained file could not be identified. Final retention-verification rows prove the successful files and are not additional retrieval attempts. The log is phase-grouped, not an exact timestamp chronology.
- Calendar dates with no returned observations are listed below; they are not assumed to be trading days. No independent official trading-calendar reconciliation was performed. Thus absent dates are not classified as holidays versus source gaps.
